transcript_notes: Spell predates the transcript coverage (2000-06 to 2025-01), so no check applies.
notes: 전두환-era minister still in office on 1988-02-25 (caretaker holdover). Announced in the 2·18 개각 of 1985 on the afternoon of 1985-02-18 (the 대통령기록관 schedule and the 대한민국사연표 date the reshuffle 1985-02-18). The new cabinet received the 임명장 on the morning of 1985-02-19 and his 이취임식 with 김정례 was held at 14:00 that day (조선일보 1985-02-20, 동아일보 1985-02-19 p.10), so the start is the 임명장 day, which is also the MOHW date. The whole 5공 cabinet handed in blanket resignations after the last 국무회의 on 1988-02-24 and 노태우 accepted them on the morning of 1988-02-25, then appointed the new cabinet, which included his successor 권이혁 (조선일보 1988-02-26, 매일경제 1988-02-25, 중앙일보 1988-02-25). He was not reappointed, so end_reason is replaced and the end is the handover day. MOHW prints 1988-02-24 as his last day (day-before convention) and ko.wikipedia 1988-02-25. Gender from the 1985-02-19 profiles, which name his wife. Birth date from the MOHW 약력 (solar). Later 서울특별시장 (MOHW 약력, not used for dates). No gazette files exist before 2001.

notes: Appointed by 전두환 in the 8·26 개각 while 주유엔대사 (named 1986-08-26, 동아일보 1986-08-26). The other nine new ministers received their 임명장 on 1986-08-27, the date the 외교부 page gives as his start. He was still in New York, 차관 李相玉 stood in for him at the 1986-08-27 국무회의 (한국일보 1986-08-28), and he received his own 임명장 on 1986-09-01 after returning on 08-31. Start follows the batch date on the ministry page, hence medium confidence. ko.wikipedia gives 1986-08-26. The spell ends on 1988-02-25 because the collective resignation of the 제5공화국 cabinet was accepted on the morning of 1988-02-25, and 노태우 then reappointed him the same day (next spell). end_reason 'resigned' records that formal acceptance, as finance.ext88.json (사공일), justice.ext88.json (정해창) and interior.ext88.json (이상희) code the same event. It is not a departure, since the two spells are one continuous stay in office. He held office on 1988-02-25 under this appointment until the acceptance, which puts this spell in the window. The 외교부 page lists 최광수 as a single 21대 entry 1986.08.27 - 1988.12.05, while ko.wikipedia splits the same 대수 into 1986-08-26..1988-02-24 and 1988-02-25..1988-12-05. notes: 전두환-era holdover. The whole 김정렬 cabinet submitted resignations on 1988-02-24 and 노태우 accepted them on the morning of 1988-02-25 before giving the new cabinet its 임명장 that morning, so he was in office for part of 1988-02-25 and the handover to 윤근환 was same-day. The mafra page prints 1988.02.24 (its day-before convention). As to the start, the 개각 was announced on the afternoon of 1987-05-18 (chronology and 매일경제 date the appointment to the 18th) and the 임명장 was given on the morning of 1987-05-19, which is also the mafra date. Birth date and hanja from ko.wikipedia '김주호 (1933년)' revid 41473557 (https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=41473557, snapshot roster/sources/agriculture/ext88/wiki/wiki_person_김주호_(1933년).json, accessed 2026-09-26T09:24:47-0400). The hanja are also printed in the 1987-05-20 조선일보 story.

notes: 전두환-era minister still in office on 1988-02-25, the first day of the window (caretaker holdover for a few hours). The whole 제5공화국 cabinet handed in resignations on 1988-02-24 as the 전두환 term ended at midnight, the resignations were accepted on the morning of the 25th, and the 노태우 cabinet received its 임명장 later that day. Before the inauguration the government stated that the incumbent ministers would attend it as 국무위원 and that the new ministers' authority began with the 11:40 임명장 ceremony (중앙일보 1988-02-22). The end is therefore 1988-02-25, a same-day handover with 나웅배. ko.wikipedia gives 1988-02-24. The farewell ceremony at the ministry was held on 1988-02-26 together with 나웅배's 취임식. Appointed 1987-05-26 in the 전두환 reshuffle after the 박종철 case, from 재무부장관, and received the 임명장 the same afternoon (동아일보 1987-05-26). Held the 부총리 title ex officio (정부조직법 제17조③, 법률 제3854호 version, 부총리 1인 and 경제기획원장관이 겸임). No ko.wikipedia article (the 경제기획원 table links a red page) and no Wikidata item was found (searches for 정인용 and 鄭寅用, wikidata_extra.json), so birth date, gender and English name are left empty. Hanja from 조선일보 1988-02-25 ('鄭寅用부총리'). 중앙일보 1987-05-26 gives his age as 52. notes: Appointed in the 1987-05-26 개각 after the 박종철 affair, with the 임명장 that afternoon (동아일보 1987-05-26). The 대한민국사연표 files the reshuffle under 1987-05-25 (tcct_1987_05_25_0010), one day before every other source. Still in office when 노태우 took office on 1988-02-25, so a 전두환-era caretaker holdover. The whole 5공 cabinet handed in blanket resignations after the last 국무회의 on 1988-02-24, and the new President accepted them on the morning of 1988-02-25 (조선일보 1988-02-26, 매일경제 1988-02-25, 중앙일보 1988-02-25). end_reason 'resigned' records that formal acceptance. He was reappointed by 노태우 the same morning (next spell), so the two spells are one continuous stay in office. The ministry page merges both into one row numbered '36,37대' (1987.05.26 ~ 1988.12.04), and ko.wikipedia lists 제36대 to 1988-02-24 and 제37대 from 1988-02-25. This file ends the first spell on 1988-02-25, the day the resignation was accepted, following the same-day handover convention of the main justice file. No gazette files exist before 2001.

notes: 전두환-era minister still in office on 1988-02-25 (caretaker holdover). Named on 1987-07-13 when he was promoted from 총무처 차관 (중앙일보 1987-07-14) and given his 임명장 on the morning of 1987-07-14 (매일경제 1987-07-14), which is the MOIS start. The MOIS page and ko.wikipedia end his term on 1988-02-24, the last day of the 전두환 presidency. He was still acting as 총무처장관 at the 10:00 inauguration on 1988-02-25 (경향신문 1988-02-25), and the resignations of the 김정렬 cabinet were accepted by 노태우 on the morning of 1988-02-25 before the new cabinet received its 임명장 (중앙일보 1988-02-25, 조선일보 1988-02-26). The end is therefore 1988-02-25, a same-day handover to 김용갑. Birth date from ko.wikipedia only (ko.wikipedia '장기오' https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=41473295 (secondary, accessed 2026-09-26T09:27:38-0400)). Not in na_members_12_22.csv (terms 12-22).

notes: Caretaker holdover of the 전두환 government into the 노태우 term. Named on the afternoon of 1987-07-13 (중앙일보, 대통령기록관 일정 and 대한민국사연표 date the 개각 to 07-13) and given the 국무총리서리 임명장 on the morning of 1987-07-14, the start used here and on the OPM page. Assembly consent 1987-08-07 (likms 120431, 찬성 144, 반대 72, 기권 16 per 서울신문 1987-08-08). No separate 임명장 after consent was reported, so pm_acting_until follows the OPM page (서리 to 1987.08.06, 제19대 from 1987.08.07). 헌법 제10호 부칙 제4조① deems officials in office on 1988-02-25 appointed under the new constitution, so the spell runs into the window without a new appointment. The whole 5공 cabinet submitted a joint resignation at the last 국무회의 on 1988-02-24 (한국경제 1988-02-25) and 노태우 accepted it on the morning of 1988-02-25 before giving 이현재 the 임명장 (매일경제 1988-02-25, 조선일보 1988-02-26, 중앙일보 1988-02-25). End = the day the resignation was accepted, a same-day handover with 이현재. The OPM page ends him on 1988.02.24 (last full day). The joint 이·취임식 with 이현재 took place on 1988-02-26 (동아일보 1988-02-26). Gender from 동아일보 1987-07-14 ('부인 李姫載여사'), see gender_source. Birth date from the OPM profile (tier 2) only. For the end, 동아일보 1988-02-24 reports the joint resignation handed in on 02-24 without acceptance, and 동아일보 1988-02-25 has 이현재 receiving his 임명장 at 11:40 on 02-25, so the last day is 02-24 or 02-25. notes: 전두환-era holdover in office on 1988-02-25. Named in the 1987-07-13 개각 (announced that afternoon) and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1987-07-14 (매일경제), the date on the MSIT list. The 5공 cabinet handed in its resignations on 1988-02-24 (한국경제) and 노태우 accepted them on the morning of 1988-02-25, after his term began at 0시, before the new cabinet received its 임명장 the same day (조선일보, 매일경제, 중앙일보). The end is therefore 1988-02-25, a same-day handover, and not the MSIT page's 1988-02-24. The joint 이취임식 at 과기처 was on 1988-02-26. Born in 평양, aged 53 in July 1987 (중앙일보 1987-07-14, 01100901.19870714194838001, snapshot roster/sources/science/ext88/news/articles/bk_01100901.19870714194838001.json, quote '◇박과기처▲평양출신 (53세)'), no exact birth date found. notes: Appointed by 전두환 in the 7·13 개각 of 1987. The reshuffle was announced on the afternoon of 1987-07-13 (동아일보, 조선일보 and 중앙일보 of 1987-07-14, the 대통령기록관 schedule and the 대한민국사연표 date it to the 13th) and the 임명장 was given on the morning of 1987-07-14, which is the start used here (매일경제 1987-07-14, 한국경제 1987-07-15, and the 총무처 page for his co-appointee 장기오). He was 청와대 대변인 when named and had resigned his 12th-Assembly 전국구 seat in 1986 (na_members_12_22.csv). Still in office when 노태우 took office. The 5공 cabinet handed in blanket resignations after the last 국무회의 on 1988-02-24 and the new President accepted them on the morning of 1988-02-25. Unlike seven of his colleagues he was not reappointed: the 1988-02-19 cabinet list left 정무제1장관 vacant (동아일보 1988-02-19, 조선일보 1988-02-20), and 조선일보 1988-03-02 calls him '전정무장관'. end_reason is resigned because the resignation was accepted and no successor took over that day. The post then stayed vacant until 1988-03-07 (see continuity). The press of 1987 prints the hanja 李鍾律 and 중앙일보 spells the hangul 이종율 in one place. Birth date and gender from na_members_12_22.csv.

notes: 전두환-era minister still in office on 1988-02-25 (caretaker holdover). His predecessor 이규효 was relieved on the afternoon of 1987-12-14 after campaign remarks (사표 수리 or 의원면직, per the papers), and 최동섭, then 총무처 소청심사위원장, was named the same afternoon (임명발령) and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1987-12-15. The start follows the 임명장 day, which ko.wikipedia also gives, hence medium (the 대한민국사연표 files the change under 1987-12-14). The 김정렬 cabinet handed in blanket resignations after the last 국무회의 of the 5th Republic on 1988-02-24, and 노태우 accepted them on the morning of 1988-02-25, before giving the new cabinet its 임명장 the same morning. He was one of the seven sitting ministers kept by the President-elect (named 1988-02-19), so he was reappointed that morning (next spell). The spell is split at the reappointment, as justice.ext88.json (정해창), interior.ext88.json (이상희), foreign.ext88.json (최광수) and finance.ext88.json (사공일) do for the same event. end_reason 'resigned' records the accepted blanket resignation. ko.wikipedia lists him as one row (제19대, 1987-12-15 to 1988-12-05). notes: Named in the 2·19 cabinet announcement of 1988 and appointed on 25 Feb 1988 with the first 노태우 cabinet. notes: First 노태우 cabinet. Promoted from 동력자원부 차관, named by the president-elect on 1988-02-19 and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1988-02-25 right after the inauguration. Retained in the 1988-12-05 전면개각, in which 동자부 was one of four ministries whose head stayed (see continuity), so there is no new spell at that date. The whole cabinet handed in resignations on 1990-03-16, and the 3·17 개각 announced 이희일 as his successor on the morning of Saturday 1990-03-17. The new ministers received the 임명장 on the morning of Monday 1990-03-19. No dated acceptance of his own resignation and no dated 이임식 were found, so the end is the successor's 임명장 day (inferred_from_successor, same-day handover). If the announcement took legal effect, the end would be 1990-03-17 with a vacancy on 03-18 (see issues). He was later 상공부장관 from 1990-12-27 (동아일보 1990-12-27 '전임李鳳瑞장관이 상공부장관으로 발탁'), which belongs to the industry lineage. notes: First 경제기획원장관 of the 노태우 government. Named with the cabinet by the President-elect on 1988-02-19 (한국경제 1988-02-20), moving from 상공부장관, and received the 임명장 on inauguration day, 1988-02-25. Replaced in the 1988-12-05 전면개각. The whole cabinet handed in resignations at an 8 a.m. 임시국무회의 that day and the new ministers received their 임명장 the same day, so the end is a same-day handover with 조순. ko.wikipedia says he was later 부총리 겸 통일원장관 and, from 1995, 부총리 겸 재정경제원장관 (other lineages). The moef page lists him as 재정경제원 2대. Held the 부총리 title ex officio (정부조직법 제17조③, 법률 제3854호 version, 부총리 1인 and 경제기획원장관이 겸임). notes: Reappointment by 노태우 on inauguration day. 최광수 was one of seven sitting ministers the President-elect announced as 재기용 on 1988-02-19. On 1988-02-25 the 제5공화국 cabinet's collective resignation was accepted in the morning and the PM 서리 and the 23 ministers of the announced list, the seven retained ones included, received 임명장 at 11:40 (경향신문 1988-02-26 p.4). The reading that the retained ministers were newly appointed rests on the accepted resignations, the count of 23, and the practice stated by a 총무처 official in 1993 (매일경제 1993-02-24: '만약 유임 되면 임명장만다시 받는다.'). Replaced in the 12·5 개각. The 이현재 cabinet submitted a collective resignation on the morning of 1988-12-05 and the new ministers received 임명장 that afternoon. Same-day handover. He said goodbye to the press on the afternoon of 12-05. Birth date from ko.wikipedia only.

notes: Named by 대통령당선인 노태우 on 1988-02-19 as one of the new ministers of the first 6공 cabinet (동아일보 and 중앙일보 1988-02-19). The new President gave the 임명장 to the PM 서리 and the new 국무위원 on the morning of 1988-02-25, right after his inauguration and after accepting the 5공 cabinet's blanket resignations. Former 문교부장관 and 한국교원대학교 총장. Replaced in the 12·5 전면개각 of 1988. That morning all 국무위원 handed their resignations to the President at an 임시국무회의, and the new ministers received the 임명장 the same day (경향신문 1988-12-05, 한겨레 1988-12-06). MOHW prints 1988-12-04 as the last day (day-before convention). Birth year only because the MOHW 약력 gives a lunar date (1923/07/13 음력). Gender from the 1988-02-19/20 profiles, which name his wife. Later 환경처장관 1991-1992 (environment lineage, MOHW 약력). No gazette files exist before 2001.

notes: Reappointed on inauguration day. 노태우 as 대통령당선인 named him on 1988-02-19 as one of seven ministers of the 5공 cabinet kept in the new cabinet (외무 최광수, 내무 이상희, 재무 사공일, 법무 정해창, 체육 조상호, 건설 최동섭, 체신 오명, per 동아일보 and 중앙일보 1988-02-19). The ministry page gives 1988-12-04 as the last day (day-before convention), and this file uses the handover day. He later served as 대통령 비서실장 (ministry 약력 page, not used for dates).

notes: Reappointed on inauguration day. The President-elect named him on 1988-02-19 as one of seven ministers of the 5th-Republic cabinet kept in the first 이현재 cabinet (외무 최광수, 내무 이상희, 재무 사공일, 법무 정해창, 체육 조상호, 건설 최동섭, 체신 오명). On the morning of 1988-02-25 the outgoing cabinet's resignations were accepted and the PM 서리 and the new 국무위원, the retained ones included, received 임명장 at the 청와대 (중앙일보 counts 23 국무위원, 조선일보 p.3 counts 24). No source names 최동섭 individually at that ceremony. The reading that he was newly appointed rests on the accepted resignations and on these counts, as in the peer ext88 files. Replaced in the 1988-12-05 전면개각. That morning the whole 이현재 cabinet handed in resignations at an 8 a.m. 임시국무회의, and the new ministers, 박승 among them, received the 임명장 in the afternoon, so the handover is same-day. ko.wikipedia ends him on 1988-12-05. notes: Reappointed (재기용) in the first 노태우 cabinet. The president-elect named him on 1988-02-19 as one of seven sitting ministers kept (동아일보 1988-02-19, 한국일보 and 서울신문 1988-02-20), and after the 5th-republic cabinet's resignations were accepted on the morning of 1988-02-25 he received a new 임명장 with the other 국무위원 at 11:40 that day (중앙일보 1988-02-25, 경향신문 1988-02-26, 대통령기록관 일정 1988-02-25). He sat in the 노태우 cabinet as 체육장관 (경향신문 1988-03-04 국무회의 report, 서울신문 1988-03-11 업무보고 on 1988-03-10). At the end of the spell the whole cabinet tendered resignations on the morning of 1988-12-05, and 김집 received his 임명장 at 16:00 that afternoon. ko.wikipedia shows one row for both spells, 1987-07-14 to 1988-12-04. notes: Appointed to the post left vacant since the change of government, on the morning of 1988-03-07, with the 임명장 that afternoon (동아일보 1988-03-07, 매일경제 and 조선일보 1988-03-08, 중앙일보 1988-03-07). He was a former 대통령비서실장 (동아일보 1988-03-07) and not a sitting member (he won a 13th-Assembly seat on 1988-04-26). In the 민정당 당직 개편 of the afternoon of 1988-05-02 he was named 원내총무 (subject to the caucus vote) and 이종찬 was named 정무제1장관. On the morning of 1988-05-03 the President gave 김윤환 his 원내총무 임명장 and then gave 이종찬 his 정무제1장관 임명장 (한국경제 and 한국일보 1988-05-04), so the handover day is 1988-05-03. end_reason is replaced (he moved to a party post, not to another office). The 1988-05-02 schedule entry of the 대통령기록관 records the 당직 개편 without naming the ministers. Birth date and gender from na_members_12_22.csv.

OPM prints 1990.12.26. He was a 민주정의당 전국구 member of the 13th Assembly when appointed and left the seat (NA table exit resigned_on_appointment). notes: Named and appointed on the morning of 1989-07-19 (매일경제 1989-07-19, 한국경제 1989-07-20). His successor was announced on Saturday 1990-03-17, and he held his 이임식 at 10:30 that morning (동아일보 1990-03-17), but the new ministers received their 임명장 only on the morning of Monday 1990-03-19 (한국일보 1990-03-20, 동아일보 1990-03-19). No dated acceptance of his resignation was found (the cabinet had submitted blanket resignations on 1990-03-16, 한국일보 1990-03-17), so the end is the successor's 임명장 day. If the 경질 of 03-17 took legal effect that day, the end is 1990-03-17 and 03-18 is a vacancy. ko.wikipedia gives 1990-03-17 (the announcement day). Birth date from the NA record, which agrees with ko.wikipedia '김태호 (1935년)' https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=41580142.

notes: Named in the 3·17 개각 (1990), announced on the morning of Saturday 1990-03-17, as the 공화계 member of the 민자당 to enter the cabinet. He was briefed at the ministry on Sunday 03-18, received the 임명장 on the morning of 1990-03-19 and held his 취임식 that day. The start follows the 임명장 day, which the motir page and ko.wikipedia also print (medium, see issues). Retained at the 1990-12-27 reshuffle (동아일보 1990-12-27 '교체설이 나돌던 李熺逸장관이유임') and the 1991-02-18 reshuffle (see continuity). Replaced on Sunday 1991-05-26 while on a trip to the Middle East, where he learned of it by telephone from Saudi Arabia. The successor 진념 received the 임명장 on the morning of 1991-05-27 and held his 취임식 at 16:00 that day. No dated 면직 or 이임식 was found, so the end is the successor's 임명장 day (inferred_from_successor). notes: Named on 1990-03-17 (notified at dawn that day) and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1990-03-19, the day of the new cabinet's first 국무회의. Retained (유임) in the 12·27 개각 of 1990, as reported by 동아일보 1990-12-27 p.1 "총리에 盧在鳳(노재봉)씨" (Naver News Library article 1990122700209201001, OCR text: '李季順정무제2장관과 崔相曄법제처장관은 유임됐다', viewer https://newslibrary.naver.com/viewer/index.naver?articleId=1990122700209201001&editNo=2&printCount=1&publishDate=1990-12-27&officeId=00020&pageNo=1&printNo=21341&publishType=00020, accessed 2026-09-26T09:07:59-0400; snapshot roster/sources/gender/ext88/newslib/nl_1990122700209201001.json), 경향신문 1990-12-27 p.2 "政務(정무)2 李季順(이계순)" (Naver News Library article 1990122700329202046, OCR text: '政務2 李季順 <留>', viewer https://newslibrary.naver.com/viewer/index.naver?articleId=1990122700329202046&editNo=3&printCount=1&publishDate=1990-12-27&officeId=00032&pageNo=2&printNo=13927&publishType=00020, accessed 2026-09-26T10:13:16-0400; snapshot roster/sources/gender/ext88/newslib/nl_1990122700329202046.json) and 서울신문 1990-12-28 "새 내각 명단" (BigKinds news_id 01100611.20160421001308809, full text: '●정무2 이계순 유 63 대구', https://www.bigkinds.or.kr/news/detailView.do?docId=01100611.20160421001308809&returnCnt=1&sectionDiv=1000, accessed 2026-09-26T10:13:42-0400; snapshot roster/sources/gender/ext88/bigkinds/bk_01100611.20160421001308809.json). No new 임명장 for her was reported, so this file keeps one spell (ko.wikipedia splits her at 1990-12-27 into 4대 and 5대, see issues). Replaced in the 12·19 개각 of 1991. The announcement came on the afternoon of 1991-12-19 and the successor received the 임명장 on the morning of 1991-12-20, so the end is 1991-12-20 by the successor rule (the ministry list prints 1991-12-19). 조선일보 1990-03-20 calls her '여성장관인 李季順신임정무2장관'. Birth date from ko.wikipedia '이계순 (1927년)' https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=42381576 ('출생일 = 1927년 3월 3일', tier 4, secondary, accessed 2026-09-26T13:12:22-0400; snapshot roster/sources/gender/ext88/wiki/person_이계순_(1927년).json), consistent with the age of 63 printed in the 1990 cabinet lists. Not an MP. [verifier 2026-09-26] Start re-checked with 한국일보 and 한겨레 of 1990-03-18, 서울신문 and 경향신문 of 1990-03-19, 경향신문 1990-03-20 and 매일경제 1990-03-22 (which calls her the 제3대 정무제2장관). The retention (유임) in the 12·27 개각 of 1990 is confirmed by 한겨레 and 서울신문 of 1990-12-28 (neither cited by the builder), so one spell is right and the ko.wikipedia split at 1990-12-27 is not followed. 매일경제 1991-12-21 numbers her successor the 4th 정무제2장관, which counts her once. 조선일보 1991-05-27 calls 金榮禎 정무2장관 in her time, a slip, since 동아일보 1991-05-29 has her as 정무제2장관. End re-checked with 세계일보 1991-12-20, 조선일보 1991-12-20 and 1991-12-21 (임명장 on the morning of 1991-12-20). Status confirmed. He resigned over the 1991-04-26 death of 명지대생 강경대 and the President accepted the resignation on the evening of 1991-04-27 (동아일보 1991-04-28, 서울신문 1991-04-28, 국민일보 1991-04-29). The successor's 임명장 came only on 1991-04-29, so 1991-04-28 is a one-day vacancy (see continuity and issues). The MOIS page ends him on 1991-04-28 under its day-before convention. Birth date from ko.wikipedia only (ko.wikipedia '안응모' https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=41631961 (secondary, accessed 2026-09-26T09:43:47-0400, snapshot in roster/sources/interior/ext88/wiki_bio/)).

notes: Named on 1990-03-17 while a visiting scholar at Harvard, returned on the evening of 1990-03-18 (경향신문 1990-03-19) and received the 임명장 with the other new ministers on the morning of 1990-03-19. Start is the 임명장 day, which the ministry page and the pages of the other ministries in the same reshuffle (내무부, 보건사회부, 총무처, 동력자원부, 과학기술처, 통일원) also print. The 대한민국사연표 files the reshuffle under the 1990-03-17 announcement. Replaced in the 1991-05-26 개각 after the 노재봉 cabinet fell. The ministry page prints the end as '1991.05.2' (truncated in the HTML), and ko.wikipedia gives 1991-05-26, the announcement day. This file ends the spell on 1991-05-27, when the successor received the 임명장 (inferred_from_successor). He later served as 감사원장 (ministry 약력 page). Verifier: 한겨레 1991-05-28 says the four ministers of the 1991-05-26 개각 were '임명·발령' on the afternoon of 1991-05-26, while 세계일보 and 중앙일보 put the 임명장 on 1991-05-27 and the 법무부 and 동력자원부 pages print 1991-05-27. The end is kept on the 임명장 day as in the other reshuffles.

notes: Named in the 3·17 개각 of 1990 (announced 1990-03-17, a Saturday). The 임명장 was given on the morning of 1990-03-19 and the 취임식 followed at 10:30 that day. Start uses 03-19, the 임명장 date also printed by the ministry pages for the same reshuffle (총무처 이연택 1990-03-19). Replaced in the 12·27 개각 of 1990, when the successor was named and given the 임명장 in the afternoon of 1990-12-27. His own 면직 date was not found, so end is the successor's appointment day (same-day handover). Wikipedia gives 1990-12-26. The same day 법률 제4268호 renamed the ministry 체육청소년부, so his spell runs one day past the 체육부 period in offices_1988.json (to 1990-12-26). His 13th-Assembly seat ran to 1992-05-29 with exit term_end in na_members_12_22.csv, so he held it while minister. No English Wikipedia interlanguage link (https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&prop=langlinks&lllang=en&format=json&redirects=1&titles=%EC%A0%95%EB%8F%99%EC%84%B1, accessed 2026-09-26T09:24:36-0400), so name_en is null. notes: Named in the 3·17 개각 of 1990 (announced on the morning of 1990-03-17) and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1990-03-19 with the other new ministers. The start follows the 임명장 day and is medium because the announcement came two days before (see issues). ko.wikipedia also gives 1990-03-19. Retained in the 9·19 부분개각 of 1990, which changed only 농림수산, 건설 and 환경처 (continuity). Replaced in the 12·27 개각 of 1990. He came to work as usual on the morning of 1990-12-27, the reshuffle was announced that morning, and the new ministers, 임인택 among them, received the 임명장 that afternoon, so the handover is same-day. Former 총무처 차관, 전남지사 and 내무차관. ko.wikipedia has no article on him (the list links a missing page '김창식 (정치인)') and no Wikidata item was found, so birth_date is null. notes: Named in the 12·27 개각 while 주제네바대사. The ministry page and the day's reports give 1990-12-27, the day the new ministers were 임명·발령 and the others received 임명장. His own 임명장 and 취임식 were on 1990-12-31. Start follows the ministry page, hence medium confidence. Retained at the 1991-05 and 1992-10-09 reshuffles (see continuity). Last day set to 1993-02-25. 중앙일보 of 1993-02-25 reports that the outgoing 현승종 cabinet resigned that day and that all resignations were accepted, and the 김영삼 cabinet was appointed on 1993-02-26. This is a single report. The ministry page, ko.wikipedia and Wikidata give 1993-02-26 (the page prints the successor's start as every end date), 매일경제 of 1993-02-24 had reported the 총무처 view that no resignation was needed, and 동아일보 1993-02-26 p.3 reports the outgoing 부총리 최각규 holding his 이임식 on the morning of 02-26. Hence medium confidence (see issues). Birth date not established. Wikidata Q117327463 has the year 1934 only, and there is no ko.wikipedia article. The 13th-Assembly member 이상옥 (李相玉, born 1950-03-22, 평화민주당, na_members_12_22.csv) is a different person, so mp_hint is null. Age 57 in 세계일보 1992-10-10. Verifier note of 2026-09-26. The last day was changed from 1993-02-25 to 1993-02-26. 조선일보 1993-02-24 p.3 reports the government's explanation that the 6共 PM and ministers stay in office until their successors are formally appointed, and the new cabinet was appointed on 1993-02-26 with the 임명장 that afternoon. Outgoing ministers of the same cabinet came to work and held their 이임식 on 1993-02-26 (서울신문, 서울경제, 국민일보 and 한겨레, stories the builder did not cite), and the 외교부 page gives 1993.02.26. The single contrary report is 중앙일보 1993-02-25 ('25일 일괄사표를 제출,전원 수리됐다'), kept in end_sources. The handover to 한승주 is now same-day, as at the other handovers of this file and in the other ext88 lineages for this transition.

notes: Appointed in the 12·27 개각 of 1990 (국무총리서리 노재봉), moving from 대통령 정무수석비서관. On 1992-06-05 the 청와대 announced that he would become 민자당 대표최고위원(김영삼) 비서실장 and that 손주환 would succeed him, both with effect from 1992-06-08 (8일자). notes: First head of 체육청소년부. Named in the 12·27 개각 of 1990 (announced that morning) and given the 임명장 in the afternoon of 1990-12-27, the day 법률 제4268호 took effect and renamed 체육부 to 체육청소년부 (offices_1988.json OFA20). The press used several titles that week. 동아일보, 경향신문 and 한겨레 wrote 체육청소년부장관, 매일경제 '청소년체육부(前체육부)장관', and 경향신문 1990-12-28 reports that at his 취임식 on 1990-12-28 he stressed becoming first minister of the 체육청소년부 'born on 1991-01-01'. 국가기록원 dates the new ministry to 1991-02-01 (직제). Office title follows the statute (see issues). He kept his 전국구 seat, per 매일경제 1990-12-28 p.2 "朴哲彥(박철언) 체육장관 議員職(의원직) 사퇴안해" (Naver News Library article 1990122800099202010, OCR text: '전국구의원직을사퇴하지 않겠다는 입장을밝혔다'; POST https://newslibrary.naver.com/api/article/detail/json articleId=1990122800099202010; accessed 2026-09-26T09:44:12-0400; snapshot roster/sources/sports/ext88/articles/nl_1990122800099202010.json). Replaced in the 12·19 개각 of 1991. His 면직 date was not found, so end is the successor's 임명장 day (1991-12-20). The two Wikipedia tables give 1991-12-19 and 1991-12-18. No English Wikipedia interlanguage link (https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&prop=langlinks&lllang=en&format=json&redirects=1&titles=%EB%B0%95%EC%B2%A0%EC%96%B8, accessed 2026-09-26T09:24:37-0400), so name_en is null. Birth date and gender come from na_members/na_members_12_22.csv (mona_cd DQE3331P, 朴哲彦, birth 1942-08-05, gender 남), ko.wikipedia '박철언' https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=42434102 (birth field '{{출생일과 만나이|1942|8|5}}', accessed 2026-09-26T09:24:36-0400, snapshot roster/sources/sports/ext88/persons/kowiki_박철언.json, secondary) and Wikidata Q12597255 (P21 male, P569 1942-08-05, accessed 2026-09-26T09:35:56-0400, snapshot roster/sources/sports/ext88/persons/wikidata_persons.json, secondary). [verifier 2026-09-26] end_reason corrected from 'replaced' to 'resigned_to_run'. The press of 19-20 Dec 1991 reported that he left the cabinet in the 12·19 개각 because he would stand for a 지역구 seat in the 14th general election (동아일보 1991-12-20 p.3, 한겨레 1991-12-20, 경향신문 1991-12-19). He ran in 대구 수성구갑 on 1992-03-24 and won (na_members_12_22.csv, 14th term from 1992-05-30). 이연택 (general_affairs.ext88), who left in the same reshuffle to run in 전주, is coded the same way. The end date stays on the successor's 임명장 day, 1991-12-20.

notes: Named on the evening of 1991-04-27 when 안응모's resignation was accepted (동아일보, 한겨레 1991-04-28) and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1991-04-29 (서울신문 1991-04-30), the date the MOIS page and ko.wikipedia print. Moved to 국가안전기획부장 in the reshuffle announced on the afternoon of 1992-03-30. He and his successor 이동호 received their 임명장 on 1992-03-31 (중앙일보, 국민일보 1992-03-31, 서울신문 1992-04-01). 한겨레 1992-03-31 writes that he was 임명·발령 as 안기부장 on 03-30. The end follows the successor's 임명장 day (inferred_from_successor). If the 03-30 발령 took effect that day, the end is 1992-03-30 and 03-31 is covered by the successor only. end_reason 'other' = moved to 국가안전기획부장. No ko.wikipedia biography was found (the disambiguation page '이상연' links a missing article), so birth_date is null.

notes: Appointed 국무총리서리 on the morning of 1991-05-24 while abroad as a presidential envoy in Africa (중앙일보, 동아일보, 국민일보 1991-05-24). He returned on 1991-05-25, took part in the 5·26 부분개각 as 서리 (the 4 ministers were named on his 제청 on 1991-05-26, 조선일보 1991-05-27) and received the 서리 임명장 with the new ministers on the morning of 1991-05-27, followed by his 취임식 (동아일보 1991-05-27, 한겨레 and 경향신문 1991-05-28). Start stays 1991-05-24, the appointment date in every official list and day-of report, because he exercised the PM's 제청 power before the 임명장. See issues. Consent 1991-07-08 (likms 131229, 찬성 203, 반대 65 per 한겨레 and 한국일보 1991-07-09). pm_acting_until follows OPM (서리 to 1991.07.07). He collected the cabinet's joint resignation on 1992-10-07 after 현승종 was named for the 중립선거관리내각, and held the joint 이·취임식 with 현승종 on the afternoon of 1992-10-08 after 현승종 received his 임명장 (서울신문, 한겨레 1992-10-09). No acceptance date of his own resignation was reported, so end = successor's appointment day. OPM prints 1992.10.07. Gender from 동아일보 1991-05-24 ('부인 林鶴暎여사'), see gender_source. Birth date from the OPM profile only. [verifier] Start re-verified with 한겨레, 조선일보 and 한국일보 1991-05-25. End kept at 1992-10-08 (successor's 임명장 at 16:00, 한국일보 1992-10-09). 경인일보 1992-10-08 has him handing the cabinet's joint resignation, his own included, to 노태우 on the afternoon of 10-07. 세계일보 1992-10-08 p.1 says the resignation was accepted on 10-07, but the same paper's editorial expects the resignations to be taken after the 10-08 consent, and 서울신문 1994-04-27 says that from 현승종 on the PM was appointed only after consent. The 10-07 reading is recorded as contrary evidence, not adopted. Status disputed. The value kept is the better-supported one, and the contrary sources are listed below and in verification.disputes. notes: Named on the afternoon of Sunday 1991-05-26 in the reshuffle that followed 정원식's appointment as 국무총리서리, and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1991-05-27 with 취임식 at 16:00 that day. The start follows the 임명장 day (medium, see issues). Retained through the 1991-12-19, 1992-03-30, 1992-06-25 and 1992-10-09 reshuffles (see continuity). Last 동력자원부장관. He stayed past the 1993-02-25 inauguration of 김영삼. The 이임식 was first planned for the afternoon of 02-25 and then held on the morning of 1993-02-26, the day the first 김영삼 cabinet was named and received the 임명장 (14:00). The new cabinet had no 동력자원부장관, because the 정부조직법 amendment merging the ministry into 상공자원부 had passed the Assembly. 총무처 treated him as 의원면직 and ruled that the 차관 would act until the amendment took effect (매일경제 1993-02-27). end_reason is 'resigned' because he left by 의원면직 while the office still existed. It was abolished on 1993-03-06. The motir page and ko.wikipedia print 1993-02-25. The same person later served as 노동부장관 (education.ext88.json cites 조선일보 1997-08-06 '陳稔(진념)노동장관도 교체'), as 기획예산위원회 위원장, which was not a 국무위원 office (budget.verified.json), and as 기획예산처장관 and 재정경제부장관 (budget.verified.json, finance.verified.json). notes: Former 검찰총장. The 개각 was announced on the afternoon of Sunday 1991-05-26 (조선일보, 중앙일보 1991-05-27) and the 임명장 was given on the morning of 1991-05-27, which the ministry page and the 동력자원부 page (진념, same reshuffle) print as the start. The 대한민국사연표 dates the appointment 1991-05-26 (announcement). The 정원식 cabinet handed in blanket resignations on 1992-10-07 before the 중립내각. On 1992-10-09 the President named four new ministers including 이정우 at 법무부 and returned the resignations of the ministers who stayed (한국일보 1992-10-10), so 김기춘's resignation took effect that day. The acceptance is implied, not stated, hence end_confidence medium. The ministry page lists 1992-10-08 (day-before convention). Birth date and gender from na_members/na_members_12_22.csv (mona_cd of the 15th-17th term member 김기춘 金淇春, hanja matches the ministry page). He was not an Assembly member at the time of this spell. Verifier: end_confidence raised from medium to high. 국민일보 1992-10-10 reports that the 이임식 of 김기춘 and the 취임식 of 이정우 were held in the 법무부 auditorium on the morning and the afternoon of 1992-10-09, and 경향신문 1992-10-10 that the resignations of the ministers who stayed were returned that day.

notes: Former 육군참모총장 (동아일보 1991-12-19 '李鎭三(이진삼)전육군참모총장'), named in the 12·19 개각 of 1991 (announced in the afternoon of 1991-12-19) and given the 임명장 at 09:30 on 1991-12-20, 취임식 at 11:00 (부산일보 1991-12-21). Start uses the 임명장 date, which the 문화부 tab of the MCST page also uses for the same reshuffle (이수정 1991-12-20). Wikipedia gives 1991-12-19. Last 체육청소년부장관. He stayed in office past the 1993-02-25 inauguration of 김영삼 and left on 1993-02-26, the day the new cabinet was named, with 의원면직 and a farewell ceremony that afternoon. No successor was appointed because the 정부조직법 amendment merging the ministry into 문화체육부 had passed the Assembly, per 조선일보 1993-02-25 p.25 "한국스포츠 위상제고에 큰기여" (Naver News Library article 1993022500239125006, OCR text: '체육청소년부가 정부조직법 개정안의 국회통과로출범 11년만에 닻을 내렸다'; POST https://newslibrary.naver.com/api/article/detail/json articleId=1993022500239125006; accessed 2026-09-26T09:44:13-0400; snapshot roster/sources/sports/ext88/articles/nl_1993022500239125006.json). The amendment (법률 제4541호) was promulgated and took effect on 1993-03-06. end_reason is 'resigned' because he left by 의원면직 at the change of government while the office still existed. The office then had no minister until it was abolished (see acting and issues). Later 18th-Assembly member (2008-2012, na_members_12_22.csv mona_cd LR83348R), not a member in 1991-1993. No English Wikipedia interlanguage link (https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&prop=langlinks&lllang=en&format=json&redirects=1&titles=%EC%9D%B4%EC%A7%84%EC%82%BC, accessed 2026-09-26T09:24:38-0400), so name_en is null. [verifier 2026-09-26] End 1993-02-26 kept but disputed. His own 이임식 was on the afternoon of 1993-02-26 (충청투데이 and 경향신문 of 1993-02-27, besides the builder's 매일경제 and 조선일보), and the 총무처 reading of 1993-02-24 was that 노태우's ministers stay until the new president appoints their successors. Against this, 중앙일보 1993-02-25 (BigKinds 01100901.19930225151908002) reports that all outgoing ministers resigned on 25 Feb and that every resignation was accepted ('25일 일괄사표를 제출,전원 수리됐다'), and 조선일보 1993-02-26 p.7 has 동력자원부, in the same position, without a minister from 26 Feb. notes: Named on 1992-05-23 as successor-designate (내정) with the 민자당 당3역 개편, formally appointed and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1992-05-25 (동아일보 1992-05-25, 조선일보, 경향신문 and 경인일보 1992-05-25/26). ko.wikipedia gives 1992-05-24 and the 대한민국사연표 1992-05-25. He was a sitting 13th-Assembly member and had been elected to the 14th for 서울 노원을. On 1992-07-20 the Supreme Court recount reversed that result, he handed his resignation to the Prime Minister on 1992-07-21, and the President accepted it on 1992-07-22 when naming his successor (중앙일보 1992-07-23). na_members_12_22.csv ends his 14th-Assembly seat on 1992-09-08 (disqualified). The 대한민국사연표 files the successor's appointment under 1992-07-23. Later 건설교통부장관 in 2001 (land.verified.json). Birth date and gender from na_members_12_22.csv.

The first 김영삼 cabinet was named on the morning of 1993-02-26 and received its 임명장 that afternoon (동아일보 1993-02-26). Earlier 총무처장관 1990-03-19..1991-12-20 (general_affairs lineage). 노태우's term ended at midnight on 1993-02-24, but ministers had no fixed term and stayed until the new President appointed successors (매일경제 1993-02-24 p.2, 세계일보 1993-02-25). He was therefore in office under 김영삼 on 1993-02-25 and until 이인제 was appointed on 1993-02-26. No report of his own 이임식 was found, so the end is the successor's appointment day. ko.wikipedia ends him on 1993-02-25. VERIFIER: end disputed, value kept at 1993-02-26. 중앙일보 1993-02-25 (BigKinds 01100901.19930225151908002) reports that the outgoing cabinet's resignations were submitted and all accepted on 1993-02-25, which would end the spell on 1993-02-25. Against it, 조선일보 1993-02-24 p.3 reports the government view that the 6공 ministers serve until successors are formally appointed, and 동아일보 1993-02-26 p.3 and 서울신문 1993-02-27 report outgoing ministers of other ministries holding their 이임식 on the morning of 1993-02-26. No labor-specific exit report was found (News Library and BigKinds searches for 이연택 1993-02-20..03-02). No tier-1 record settles the date. notes: Named on the afternoon of 1992-07-22 to succeed 김용채 (한겨레 1992-07-23 writes 임명·발령). The 임명장 was first announced for the 23rd (서울신문, 경인일보 1992-07-23) and was given on the morning of 1992-07-24 (한국일보, 전북도민일보 and 중부매일 1992-07-25). start follows the 임명장 day as elsewhere in this file, and the confidence is medium because the formal 발령 may carry 1992-07-22, the date ko.wikipedia gives (see issues). Sitting 14th-Assembly member. Replaced in the 중립내각 reshuffle of 1992-10-09, when the President accepted the resignations of the 안기부장 and four ministers including 정무1 and returned the others (경향신문 1992-10-10). 경향신문 1992-10-10 counts him among those who left in that reshuffle. His successor received the 임명장 on the afternoon of 1992-10-09. Birth date and gender from na_members_12_22.csv. [verifier 2026-09-26] Start disputed between 1992-07-22 (appointment reported by every paper, 한겨레 '임명·발령') and 1992-07-24 (임명장, kept). 동아일보 1992-07-25 p.2 has him paying his 취임인사 on the 23rd. notes: Named (내정) on 1992-10-07 to lead the 중립선거관리내각 (대한민국사연표, 경향신문 1992-10-08). The motion was submitted the same day. Consent and 임명장 on 1992-10-08 (likms 140058, 찬성 266, 반대 9, 기권 1, 무효 1 per 경향신문 1992-10-09). He was never styled 서리 in the official list. One report calls him '현승종총리서리' on 1992-10-07 (세계일보 1992-10-08), which reads as loose usage for 내정자. He stayed in office past 노태우's term (ended 1993-02-24 24:00) until 김영삼 appointed 황인성 on the afternoon of 1993-02-25. 매일경제 1993-02-24 reports that ministers had no fixed term and that 현승종 would stay until 황인성 received his 임명장 and the 이취임식 was held. The 이·취임식 was on 1993-02-26 (조선일보 1993-02-27). End is the successor's appointment day. OPM prints 1993.02.24. Hanja 玄勝鍾 as printed in the newspapers (ko.wikipedia writes 玄勝種). Gender from 경향신문 1992-10-08 ('부인 洪榮杓(홍영표)여사'), see gender_source. Birth date from the OPM profile only. [verifier] Start kept at 1992-10-08 with pm_status 정식. Two same-day reports say 노태우 appointed him 총리서리 on the afternoon of 10-07 (한국일보 and 세계일보 1992-10-08, citing the 청와대 spokesman), and the builder called such reports loose usage after seeing only one of them. Against them are 서울신문 1992-10-08 (내정), the plenary minutes of 10-08 (the ballot names '현승종 씨', while the 1988-1991 ballots name the nominee 국무총리서리), the 대통령기록관 schedule (임명장 on 10-08 only), OPM (no 서리 row) and 서울신문 1994-04-27, which dates the end of the 서리 practice to 현승종. If the 10-07 서리 appointment were adopted, start would be 1992-10-07 with pm_acting_until 1992-10-07 and 정원식 would end on 10-07. End re-verified with 부산일보 and 서울신문 1993-02-26 (현승종 already 전 총리 at the 17:00 reception on 02-25). Status disputed. The value kept is the better-supported one, and the contrary sources are listed below and in verification.disputes. The end follows the successor's 임명장 day. The MOIS page ends him on 1993-02-25 under its day-before convention. notes: Former 대법원 판사 and 법원행정처장, the first judge to head the ministry (한겨레 1992-10-10). Appointed to the 현승종 중립선거관리내각 on 1992-10-09 (named that morning, 임명장 that afternoon). Served past the 1993-02-25 inauguration of 김영삼 as a caretaker holdover. On 1993-02-24 the 총무처 view reported by 매일경제 was that ministers had no fixed term, did not need to resign en bloc to the new President, and would hand over when successors were appointed. notes: Appointed in the 10·9 중립내각 reshuffle of 1992 (국무총리 현승종 제청), announced in the morning with the 임명장 in the afternoon of 1992-10-09. He stayed in office into the 김영삼 presidency. According to the 총무처 reading reported by 매일경제 (1993-02-24), the 현승종 cabinet did not have to tender a collective resignation and each minister would hand over when a successor was appointed. The new cabinet, with 오인환 as 공보처장관, was announced on the morning of 1993-02-26 and received its 임명장 that afternoon, and other outgoing ministers (최각규, 이진삼, 진념) held their 이임식 on 1993-02-26. No report of his own 이임식 was found (News Library and BigKinds searched for 유혁인/柳赫仁 1993-02-21 to 1993-04-30), so end is set to the successor's appointment day. ko.wikipedia '대한민국 공보처' and '류혁인' give 1993-02-25. The surname is written 柳 (유혁인 in the papers of the time, 류혁인 on ko.wikipedia). Birth year only, from ko.wikipedia '류혁인' (tier 4). 연합뉴스 1999-01-29 (https://n.news.naver.com/mnews/article/001/0004437011, accessed 2026-09-26T09:35:30-0400, snapshot roster/sources/public_info/ext88/news/naver_001_0004437011.html) reports his death at 향년 65세. Gender from the same obituary, which names his wife.

notes: Named on the morning of 1992-10-09 in the 중립내각 reshuffle (현승종 제청), 임명장 that afternoon. He was a 중앙일보 고문 and not an Assembly member. He was first slated for 공보처 and the two posts were swapped at the last moment (조선일보, 매일경제 1992-10-09/10). Still in office on 1993-02-20 (매일경제 1993-02-20, 서울신문 1993-02-21) and into the 김영삼 presidency. The first 김영삼 cabinet was named on the morning of 1993-02-26 and received the 임명장 that afternoon (동아일보 1993-02-26, 전북일보 1993-02-26), so the end is the successor's appointment day, as in the sibling files for 내무부, 공보처 and 총무처. 중앙일보 1993-02-25 alone reports that the outgoing cabinet's resignations were submitted and all accepted on 1993-02-25, and ko.wikipedia ends him on 1993-02-25 (see issues). No ko.wikipedia article exists for him (the list links a missing page). birth_date is the year only, from 국민일보 1992-10-09 ('33년 서울에서 태어나'), and gender M from 세계일보 1992-10-10, which names his wife ('부인 이혜경씨'). notes: Named in the first 김영삼 cabinet on the morning of 1993-02-26 and given his 임명장 that afternoon. Replaced in the 12·21 reshuffle, announced on the afternoon of 1993-12-21 (outgoing ministers such as 허신행 held their 이임식 that afternoon, 동아일보 1993-12-22). The successor's 임명장 followed on the morning of 1993-12-22. The end is the day he was relieved, as in the MOE list. If the legal end is tied to the successor's 임명장, it would be 1993-12-22. notes: Named in the first 김영삼 cabinet on the morning of 1993-02-26 and given the 임명장 that afternoon. Former 한국여자의사회 회장. Resigned after reports of property speculation. She told 비서실장 박관용 on the afternoon of 1993-03-07 that she would step down (동아일보 1993-03-08), and the President accepted the resignation and appointed 송정숙 on the afternoon of 1993-03-08 (세계일보 1993-03-09 '이날짜로 수리', 조선일보 and 경향신문 1993-03-09). The 동아일보 1993-03-08 p.3 photo caption says the resignations were accepted on the 7th, against the other reports. The end is the acceptance day, a same-day handover. MOHW prints 1993-03-07 (day-before convention). ko.wikipedia prints 1993-02-25 as the start, one day before every other source. Birth year only because the MOHW 약력 gives a lunar date (1935/03/29 음력). Gender from the MOHW 약력 (경기여자고등학교, 한국여의사회 회장) and 국민일보 1993-02-26 (three women in the cabinet).

notes: Member of the first 김영삼 cabinet, named on the morning of 1993-02-26 and given the 임명장 that afternoon. Sitting 14th-Assembly member. Like the other ministers he handed in his resignation after the PM change of 1993-12-16 (동아일보 1993-12-21). Replaced in the 12·21 개각 of 1993, announced on 1993-12-21, with the new ministers' 임명장 on the morning of 1993-12-22 (경향신문 1993-12-23, 서울신문 and 한겨레 1993-12-23). notes: 감사원장, named on 1993-12-16 after 황인성's resignation was accepted. The Assembly consented the same afternoon (찬성 220, 반대 36, 기권 2, 무효 2 per 국민일보 1993-12-17) and he received the 임명장 on the morning of 1993-12-17, followed by his 취임식 (경향신문 1993-12-18, 국민일보 and 세계일보 1993-12-17). 한겨레 1993-12-18 calls 12-17 the day of his formal appointment. The 대통령기록관 schedule, the 대한민국사연표 and 경향신문 1993-12-17 date the appointment to 12-16, see issues. Start is the 임명장 day, as on the OPM page. He handed in his resignation at 17:00 on 1994-04-22 after a clash with 김영삼 over the 통일안보정책조정회의, and 김영삼 accepted it at once (청와대 대변인 in 서울신문 and 한국일보 1994-04-23). The 청와대 framed it as a 문책성 경질, he called it voluntary. OPM prints 1994.04.21, while ko.wikipedia and all day-of sources give 04-22. His 이임식 was on 1994-04-25. 부총리 겸 경제기획원장관 정재석 acted as PM until 이영덕 took office (see acting). Later a 15th Assembly member (from 1996), not sitting when appointed. The OPM birth date equals the ALLNAMEMBER date, which ALLNAMEMBER marks 음 (lunar). [verifier] Start kept at 1993-12-17, the 임명장 day, supported by 전북일보 and 중앙일보 1993-12-17 ('17일 ... 임명') and 경향신문 1993-12-18. 국민일보 1993-12-17 ('16일 오후 임명된'), the 대통령기록관 schedule and the 대한민국사연표 date the appointment to the consent day 12-16, as the builder recorded. notes: Named in the 12·21 개각 (1993) on the afternoon of 1993-12-21 and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1993-12-22 (start follows the 임명장, see issues, and the mafra page also prints 1993.12.22). notes: Start is the 임명장 day. With no gazette file before 2001, the legal appointment date is read from the day the 임명장 was handed over. From 2001 the 관보 dates appointments announced one day before the 임명장 on the 임명장 day. Examples in the main rosters are 이헌재 2004-02-11, 김승규 2004-07-29 and 오명 2003-12-29, where the 임명장 day is reported, and 곽결호 2004-02-18 and 이재용 2005-06-29, one day after the announcement. Named on 1993-12-21 (12·21 개각) on the recommendation of PM 이회창 (한겨레 1993-12-22 profile '이총리 추천케이스', News Library 1993122200289104012, and 서울신문 1993-12-22 '총무처·환경처 이 총리 제청 수용', BigKinds 01100611.20160422071316882), 임명장 at 09:00 on 1993-12-22. Former 법제처 차장 and 경희대 교수 of administrative law. 환경처 ceased to exist at the end of 1994-12-22, when 환경부와그소속기관직제 took effect on 1994-12-23 and with it 법률 제4831호 제26조 삭제 and 제38조의2. He still held press conferences as 환경처장관 on 1994-12-21. The continuation as 환경부장관 on 1994-12-23..24 is the next spell. The ministry list ends him on 1994-12-21 and starts 김중위 that day, which the 1994-12-21/22 press contradicts. No exact birth date was found. He has no ko.wikipedia or Wikidata entry and the 1993 profiles give no age. Later papers give his age as 56 in July 1991 (경향신문 1991-07-30 p.9 '경찰위원 약력', News Library 1991073000329109017, text '朴鈗炘▲全南 寶城출생·56세', which also gives his birthplace), 59 in January 1994 (조선일보 1994-01-17 p.31, News Library 1994011700239131010, text '朴鈗炘환경처장관(59)') and 61 or 60 in February 1996 (조선일보 1996-02-08 p.46, News Library 1996020800239146016, text '朴鈗炘전환경부장관(61)', 세계일보 BigKinds 01100701.19960208000003005 '(61)', 경향신문 BigKinds 01100101.19960208000002207 '(60)' and 한국일보 BigKinds 01101101.19960208000003704 '(60)'). Depending on how each paper counted age, this puts his birth between 1934 and 1936, so birth_date stays null. notes: Legal continuation, not a separately reported tenure. 부칙 제2조① of 법률 제4831호 deems 환경처 officials to be 환경부 officials and, unlike the clauses for the merged ministries, does not exclude 정무직, so 박윤흔 held 환경부장관 from 1994-12-23 until 김중위 received the 임명장 on the morning of 1994-12-24. The vice minister shows the same carry-over. 김형철, 환경처 차관, was reported as 환경부 차관 until the 1994-12-26 vice-ministerial appointments (매일경제 1994-12-25 and 1994-12-27). All 국무위원 handed in collective resignations before the 12·23 개각 (동아일보 1994-12-24). No story naming 박윤흔 as 환경부장관 and no farewell date was found, and the press calls 김중위 the first 환경부장관. See issues for the alternative (a one-day vacancy on 1994-12-23) and the sibling lineages with the same clause. Birth date not found. The 환경처 spell notes give the ages the press reported (birth between 1934 and 1936).

notes: Continuation of the 보건사회부 spell across the renaming of 1994-12-23. 부칙 제2조① of 법률 제4831호 moves the 보건사회부장관's duties to the 보건복지부장관 and deems 보건사회부 officials to be 보건복지부 officials without the 정무직 exclusion it applies to 경제기획원, 재무부, 건설부 and 교통부, so the legal carry-over runs from 1994-12-23. 중앙일보 1994-12-24 already calls him 보건복지부장관 for a visit on 1994-12-23. The 12·23 개각 announced on the afternoon of 1994-12-23 named him to the new office. 동아일보, 경향신문 and 서울신문 1994-12-24 list him among the ministers appointed ('초대 보건복지부장관에 서상목보사부장관', '기용됐다'), which is why reappointed_on_reorg is true. 국민일보, 매일경제, 조선일보 and 한국일보 1994-12-24 call the same decision a 유임. All 국무위원 had handed in blanket resignations before the reshuffle (동아일보 1994-12-24). No report was found that he received a new 임명장 at the ceremony of the morning of 1994-12-24. See issues. Resigned over the 한약 dispute before PM 이홍구's visit to China, and 김영삼 accepted the resignation and named 이성호 on the afternoon of 1995-05-15 (한겨레, 세계일보, 서울신문 1995-05-16). MOHW prints 1995-05-15 and ko.wikipedia 1995-05-15. [verifier 2026-09-27] reappointed_on_reorg disputed (true kept). Besides the builder's sources, 동아일보 1994-12-24 p.5, 경향신문 1994-12-24 p.4 and 1994-12-25 p.3 and 동아일보 1994-12-25 p.4 call it a 유임, while 한겨레, 전자신문, 세계일보 and 전북일보 1994-12-24 list him among the 12·23 appointments. See verification.disputes. 매일경제 1994-12-28 p.40 has him acting as 보건복지부장관 on 1994-12-27.

notes: Start is the 임명장 day. With no gazette file before 2001, the legal appointment date is read from the day the 임명장 was handed over. From 2001 the 관보 dates appointments announced one day before the 임명장 on the 임명장 day. Examples in the main rosters are 이헌재 2004-02-11, 김승규 2004-07-29 and 오명 2003-12-29, where the 임명장 day is reported, and 곽결호 2004-02-18 and 이재용 2005-06-29, one day after the announcement. First 환경부장관. Named on the afternoon of 1994-12-23 (12·23 개각, 18 of 22 portfolios newly filled with the 정부조직 개편), 임명장 on the morning of 1994-12-24, the date the 법무부 list also prints for 안우만 from the same reshuffle. The ministry list and ko.wikipedia give 1994-12-21, two days before the reshuffle, which the news contradicts (see issues). Kept his Assembly seat. Left in the 12·20 개각 of 1995 to run in the April 1996 general election (경향신문 1995-12-17, 동아일보 1995-12-21 '내년4월 총선 출마때문에'), successor's 임명장 at 09:00 on 1995-12-21. The successor's 임명장 at 09:00 on 21 Dec follows the next day, so no day is uncovered. The builder's end_sources after the first entry support the successor's start.

notes: First 부총리 겸 재정경제원장관. He was 부총리 겸 경제기획원장관 (epb lineage) when 경제기획원 and 재무부 were merged into 재정경제원 on 1994-12-23 (법률 제4831호). 김영삼 kept him on (유임) in the 1994-12-23 개각, but 부칙 제2조① moves only the duties and the non-정무직 staff, so a new appointment was needed. The 임명장 was given on the morning of 1994-12-24 and his 취임식 at 재정경제원 was held the same day. The start is the 임명장 date (ministry pages of other ministries also start this reshuffle on 1994-12-24), hence start_confidence medium. ko.wikipedia gives 1994-12-23. reorg_continuation is true because his tenure as economic 부총리 continued through the merger, but the previous spell is in the epb lineage, not in this file (the last 재무부장관 was 박재윤). 1994-12-23 is a one-day vacancy of the new office. Replaced in the reshuffle announced on 1995-12-20. The successor received the 임명장 at 09:00 on 1995-12-21, so the end is the successor's start (ko.wikipedia gives 1995-12-20). Birth date 1938-03-27 from ko.wikipedia "홍재형" https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=42394707 (accessed 2026-09-26T09:04:17-0400; snapshot roster/sources/finance/ext88/wiki/wiki_홍재형_42394707.json). Gender from Wikidata Q16093141 P21 = male (accessed 2026-09-26T09:49:43-0400; snapshot roster/sources/finance/ext88/wiki/wikidata_entities.json). [verifier] end_reason corrected to resigned_to_run. The press named him from 1995-12-01 on as a certain 15대 총선 candidate for 청주, the 12-20 reshuffle replaced him for that reason, and he ran for 신한국당 in 청주 상당 on 1996-04-11 and lost (동아일보 1995-12-18, 조선일보 1995-12-18, 한겨레 1995-12-19, 동아일보 1995-12-21 and 1996-03-28, 한겨레 and 매일경제 1996-04-12). He held his farewell on 12-20, and the end stays at the successor's 임명장 on 12-21 as in finance.verified.json for 강봉균 2000. The 1996-03-28 동아일보 story reports his 58th birthday on 1996-03-27, which agrees with the birth date 1938-03-27.

notes: Named in the 12·23 개각 of 1994 while 주일대사. The batch of new ministers received 임명장 on 1994-12-24, the date on the ministry page. He was abroad, returned on 12-25, and received his own 임명장 and held his 취임식 on 1994-12-26. Start follows the ministry page, hence medium confidence. Retained in the 12·20 개각 of 1995 (한겨레 1995-12-21). He offered his resignation on 1996-11-04 through the PM, citing health, and the President accepted it on the morning of 1996-11-06. Contemporary reports also link the exit to complaints over personnel decisions and to his 1950 service in a 인민군 학도의용군 unit (서울경제 1996-11-07). The successor was named on 11-06 and received his 임명장 on 11-07, so the handover is adjacent with no vacant day. The ministry page prints 1996.11.07 as his last day by its same-day convention. notes: Named on 1994-12-23 and given the 임명장 on the morning of 1994-12-24. Her portfolio was fixed in the decree by then (정무장관실직제 제2조② as amended by 대통령령 제14417호, 1994-11-26), and from 1996-07-01 여성발전기본법시행령 named the 정무장관(제2) as the minister in charge. notes: Appointed in the 12·23 개각 of 1994 (announced on the afternoon of 1994-12-23, 임명장 on the morning of 1994-12-24). Start follows the 임명장 day, as the culture, general_affairs, interior, justice, science and other ext88 files do for this reshuffle. Some 1995 reports give 1994-12-23 as the day he was 발탁 or 취임 (중앙일보 and 세계일보 1995-05-24), which is the announcement day. Resigned under investigation for bribes taken as 산업은행 총재. He handed his resignation to the PM on the morning of 1995-05-23 and the President accepted it that afternoon, so the last day in office is 1995-05-23. He held a farewell ceremony at the ministry at 08:50 on 1995-05-24 as 전 장관 (동아일보 1995-05-25). ko.wikipedia ends him on 1995-05-24. notes: First 건설교통부장관. He was 교통부장관 (transport lineage, from 1993-12-22) when 교통부 and 건설부 were merged on 1994-12-23. 부칙 제2조① of 법률 제4831호 excludes 정무직 from the carry-over, so a new appointment was needed. He was named on the afternoon of 1994-12-23 and received the 임명장 on the morning of 1994-12-24, with his 취임식 at 14:00 that day. The start follows the 임명장 day, which the 국토교통부 page and the archived 건설교통부 page also print, hence medium. reorg_continuation and reappointed_on_reorg are true because his cabinet tenure ran on from the predecessor ministry 교통부 into the merged ministry, as finance.ext88.json does for 홍재형. The previous spell is in the transport lineage, not in this file. Replaced in the 12·20 개각 of 1995. The ministers had handed in resignations at the 1995-12-19 국무회의 (한국일보 1995-12-20), the reshuffle was announced on 1995-12-20 and the successor received the 임명장 at 09:00 on 1995-12-21. The ministry pages end him on 1995-12-20 by their day-before convention. The end is the successor's 임명장 day (inferred_from_successor). 한겨레 (1995-12-21 p.6) mentions speculation that he might run in the 1996 general election, but no source found shows that he did, so end_reason is replaced. Also 체신부장관 in 1987-1988 (a different lineage). Birth date 1940-03-21 from ko.wikipedia and Wikidata, as in science.verified.json. The archived 건설교통부 약력 page prints 1940-03-31 (see issues). notes: Named on 1995-12-20 and given the 임명장 at 09:00 on 1995-12-21, the MOIS date (ko.wikipedia gives 12-20). He offered his resignation on 1997-02-12 before reporting to the prosecutors in the 한보 case (한겨레 1997-02-13 in the search hits), and the President accepted it on 1997-02-13 and appointed 서정화 the same day (동아일보, 서울신문 1997-02-14, 국민일보 1997-02-13). He was arrested the same day (대한민국사연표 tcct_1997_02_13_0040). The MOIS page ends him on 1997-02-12 under its day-before convention. Birth date from the NA record, which agrees with ko.wikipedia '김우석 (1936년)' https://ko.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?oldid=42209274.

Replaced in the '3·5 개각' of 1997, announced on 1997-03-05 after the new PM 고건 made the 제청, with the new ministers' 임명장 on 1997-03-06. Before the reshuffle he was reported as a candidate for replacement over 한보철강 loans made while he headed the 은행감독원 (조선일보 1997-03-04). The end follows the successor's appointment on 1997-03-06, consistent with the verified start of 권숙일, and 1997-03-05 (announcement) is the alternative. Birth date not found. No ko.wikipedia article under the linked title '김용진 (정치인)' (not found, 2026-09-26). [verifier] Start re-verified (한겨레, 한국일보, 중부매일 1996-12-21, and 동아일보 1997-03-06 '지난해 12월20일 입각한'). End re-verified. 權肅一 was named on the afternoon of 1997-03-05 and received the 임명장 on the morning of 1997-03-06 (동아일보 1997-03-06, 중앙일보 and 전북도민일보 1997-03-07). He appears among the former ministers at 權肅一's gathering of 1997-03-27 (헤럴드경제 1997-03-29).

notes: Caretaker holdover of the 김영삼 government into the 김대중 term (1998-02-25 .. 1998-03-03). The consent vote on 김종필 was aborted on 1998-03-02, and 고건 recommended (제청) the first 김대중 cabinet on the morning of 1998-03-03 before 김종필 was named 서리 the same afternoon. The OPM page gives 1998.03.02 as the last day. This roster uses 1998-03-03 because two same-week reports place him in office as incumbent PM on that day (same-day handover). Start 1997-03-05 is the 임명장 day. The Assembly consent passed on 1997-03-04 (likms 150475), so 1997-03-04 is possible if the 재가 preceded the ceremony. [verifier] The resignation was accepted on 1998-03-03, after he had recommended the first 김대중 cabinet (세계일보 1998-03-04). Nomination and consent were both on 1997-03-04 (likms 150475, 세계일보 and 매일경제 1997-03-05) and the 임명장 on the morning of 03-05 (한국일보 1997-03-06). The start stays 1997-03-05.

notes: Sitting 신한국당 member for 부산 동래구을. notes: Kim Young-sam appointee still in office on 1998-02-25 (caretaker). The 8·5 개각 was announced on the afternoon of 1997-08-05 and the 임명장 were given on 1997-08-06 at 09:30, so start uses 08-06 (no digital gazette before 2001). ko.wikipedia gives 1997-08-05, and 경향신문 1997-08-06 writes '김영삼 대통령은 5일 오후 ... 임명하는 등 11개 부처 장관을 교체하는 개각을 단행했다', so 1997-08-05 is the alternative start (see issues). He held a farewell ceremony on 1998-02-24 but, like the other YS ministers, kept serving after the 1998-02-25 inauguration because the 김종필 consent vote failed (법제처 view that sitting ministers stay until successors are appointed, 한겨레 1998-02-27 BigKinds 01101001.19980227000000405). The office was abolished when 법률 제5529호 took effect on the afternoon of 1998-02-28, so the last full day is 1998-02-27 (same convention as offices.json and the sibling rosters for 공보처, 과학기술처 and 통상산업부). ko.wikipedia gives 1998-03-01. Not reappointed to any successor office (none exists). notes: YS-era holdover. 법률 제5529호 took effect on the afternoon of 1998-02-28 and turned 통상산업부 into 산업자원부. This is a de facto caretaker period, not a legal tenure in 산업자원부 (the 1998 law excludes 정무직 from the staff transfer).

notes: Moved from 여성부장관 in the first 노무현 cabinet. Resigned to run in the 2004-04-15 general election. The resignation was submitted 2004-02-15 (candidate resignation deadline). No report giving the acceptance date was found, so the end follows the ministry list and Wikipedia (2004-02-16). Birth date given as year only because na_members/na_members_15_22.csv prints 1944-03-24 and Wikipedia 1944-04-16. [verifier] End disputed. She filed her resignation with 행정자치부 on Sunday 2004-02-15, the deadline under 공직선거법 제53조①, and 제53조② deems a candidate to have left office when the resignation is received. The dailies say she 사퇴 on 2004-02-15 and call her 전 장관 from 2004-02-16.
